name: Methylated lambda modC sensitivity
definition: Sensitivity for measuring modC at mC sites calculated from a fully methylated lambda control. modC refers to a call of mC, hmC or undifferentiated modC. The value should be >= 95%

name: Non-methylated pUC19 control modC specificity
definition: Specificity for measuring modC at C sites calculated from an unmethylated pUC19 control. modC refers to a call of mC, hmC or undifferentiated modC. The value should be >= 99%

name: Methylated lambda control mC sensitivity
definition: Sensitivity for measuring mC calculated from a fully methylated lambda control. The value should be >= 93%

name: Methylated lambda control hmC specificity
definition: Specificity for measuring hmC calculated from a fully methylated lambda control

name: Non-methylated pUC19 mC specificity
definition: Specificity for measuring mC calculated from an unmethylated pUC19 control

name: Non-methylated pUC19 hmC specificity
definition: Specificity for measuring hmC calculated from an unmethylated pUC19 control

name: Non-C calls at CpG sites on fully methylated lambda control
definition: Non-C calls at CpG sites on fully methylated lambda control

name: Non-C calls at CpG sites on fully unmethylated pUC19 control
definition: Non-C calls at CpG sites on fully unmethylated pUC19 control

name: Percent hmC called as hmC on 80bp SQ2hmC mixed C/hmC short control
definition: The percentage of hmC sites correctly called as hmC on an 80bp synthetic oligo with a variety of different C and hmC states at CpGs. The value should be >= 95%

name: Genetic accuracy lambda control
definition: The overall genetic accuracy from the lambda-aligned reads as a percentage calculated relative to a lambda truth set. The value should be >= 99.9%

name: Genetic accuracy lambda control Q-score
definition: The overall genetic accuracy from the lambda-aligned reads as a q-score calculated relative to a lambda truth set.

name: Genetic accuracy lambda control A
definition: The overall genetic accuracy from the lambda-aligned reads  of A bases as a percentage calculated relative to a lambda truth set.

name: Genetic accuracy lambda control C
definition: The overall genetic accuracy from the lambda-aligned reads  of C bases as a percentage calculated relative to a lambda truth set.

name: Genetic accuracy lambda control G
definition: The overall genetic accuracy from the lambda-aligned reads  of G bases as a percentage calculated relative to a lambda truth set.

name: Genetic accuracy lambda control T
definition: The overall genetic accuracy from the lambda-aligned reads  of T bases as a percentage calculated relative to a lambda truth set.

name: Genetic accuracy lambda control Q-score A
definition: The overall genetic accuracy from the lambda-aligned reads  of A bases as a q-score calculated relative to a lambda truth set.

name: Genetic accuracy lambda control Q-score C
definition: The overall genetic accuracy from the lambda-aligned reads  of C bases as a q-score calculated relative to a lambda truth set.

name: Genetic accuracy lambda control Q-score G
definition: The overall genetic accuracy from the lambda-aligned reads  of G bases as a q-score calculated relative to a lambda truth set.

name: Genetic accuracy lambda control Q-score T
definition: The overall genetic accuracy from the lambda-aligned reads  of T bases as a q-score calculated relative to a lambda truth set.

name: Mitochondrial genome rate of C at CpG
definition: The rate of observing an unmethylated C for C calls at CpG sites in the mitochondrial genome

name: Autosomal chromosomes rate of C at CpG
definition: The rate of observing an unmethylated C for C calls at autosomal CpG sites

name: Autosomal chromosomes rate of modC at CpG
definition: The rate of observing a modified C (mC or hmC) for C calls at autosomal CpG sites

name: Autosomal chromosomes rate of mC at CpG
definition: The rate of observing an mC for C calls at autosomal CpG sites

name: Autosomal chromosomes rate of hmC at CpG
definition: The rate of observing a hmC for C calls at autosomal CpG sites

name: Mitochondrial genome rate of C at CHG
definition: The rate of observing an unmethylated C for C calls at CHG sites in the mitochondrial genome

name: Autosomal chromosomes rate of C at CHG
definition: The rate of observing an unmethylated C for C calls at autosomal CHG sites

name: Autosomal chromosomes rate of modC at CHG
definition: The rate of observing a modified C (mC or hmC) for C calls at autosomal CHG sites

name: Mitochondrial genome rate of C at CHH
definition: The rate of observing an unmethylated C for C calls at CHH sites in the mitochondrial genome

name: Autosomal chromosomes rate of C at CHH
definition: The rate of observing an unmethylated C for C calls at autosomal CHH sites

name: Autosomal chromosomes rate of modC at CHH
definition: The rate of observing a modified C (mC or hmC) for C calls at autosomal CHH sites

name: modC sites passing filters
definition: Number of ASM sites passing all filters (modC)

name: modC sites with low methylation difference
definition: Number of ASM sites that had low difference in methylation status of the 2 alleles (modC)

name: mC sites passing filters
definition: Number of ASM sites passing all filters (mC)

name: mC sites with low methylation difference
definition: Number of ASM sites that had low difference in methylation status of the 2 alleles (mC)

name: hmC sites passing filters
definition: Number of ASM sites passing all filters (hmC)

name: hmC sites with low methylation difference
definition: Number of ASM sites that had low difference in methylation status of the 2 alleles (hmC)

name: Sites with low CpG coverage at both alleles
definition: Number of ASM sites that had low CpG coverage

name: Sites with low CpG coverage at allele 1
definition: Number of ASM sites that had low CpG coverage at allele 1

name: Sites with low CpG coverage at allele 2
definition: Number of ASM sites that had low CpG coverage at allele 2

name: Sites with no CpG coverage at both alleles
definition: Number of ASM sites that had no CpG coverage at both allele

name: Sites with no CpG coverage at allele 1
definition: Number of ASM sites that had no CpG coverage at allele 1

name: Sites with no CpG coverage at allele 2
definition: Number of ASM sites that had no CpG coverage at allele 2

name: Sites with no reads
definition: Number of ASM sites that had no reads

name: Genome-mapped reads (including duplicates)
definition: The total number of genome-aligned reads including duplicates

name: Genome-mapped read duplicates
definition: The number of resolved genome-aligned reads identified and removed as potential duplicates

name: Genome-mapped duplication rate
definition: The duplication rate in the genome-aligned reads

name: Genome deduplicated reads
definition: The total number of reads in the deduplicated genome primary assembly-aligned BAM file

name: Genome deduplicated bases
definition: The total number of bases in the deduplicated genome primary assembly-aligned BAM file

name: Percent of input bases aligned to genome primary assembly
definition: The percentage of deduplicated primary genome assembly aligned bases, not including soft-clipped bases

name: Genome mean mapped bases per read
definition: The average number of bases in trimmed, resolved, genome aligned and deduplicated reads, excluding soft-clipped bases

name: Genome reads mean quality
definition: The average quality of trimmed, resolved, genome-aligned, deduplicated reads (excluding soft-clipped bases)

name: Mean coverage including Ns
definition: The mean genome-wide coverage (including Ns)

name: Mean coverage excluding Ns
definition: The mean genome-wide coverage (excluding Ns)

name: Genome percentage no coverage
definition: Percentage of the genome with no coverage (including Ns)

name: Genome percentage 1x
definition: Percentage of the genome covered at 1X or above (including Ns)

name: Genome percentage 2x
definition: Percentage of the genome covered at 2X or above (including Ns)

name: Genome percentage 5x
definition: Percentage of the genome covered at 5X or above (including Ns)

name: Genome percentage 10x
definition: Percentage of the genome covered at 10X or above (including Ns)

name: Genome percentage 25x
definition: Percentage of the genome covered at 25X or above

name: Genome percentage 30x
definition: Percentage of the genome covered at 30X or above (including Ns)

name: CpG to genome-wide coverage ratio (including Ns)
definition: Ratio of mean coverage at CpGs to mean coverage genome-wide (including Ns). Because CpGs are stranded, a 'perfect' value for the metric would be 0.5. Values > 0.5 indicate bias towards CpG; values < 0.5 indicate bias away from CpGs

name: TSS to non-TSS coverage ratio
definition: Ratio of mean coverage near transcription start sites (TSS regions) to mean coverage at regions not near transcription start sites. A 'perfect' value for the metric would be 1.0. Values > 1.0 indicate bias towards TSS regions; values < 1.0 indicate bias away from TSS regions

name: Reads after trimming and quality filtering
definition: The total number of read-pairs (R1/R2 read-pairs) remaining after trimming and quality filtering

name: Bases after trimming and quality filtering
definition: The total number of base-pairs (R1/R2 base-pairs) remaining after trimming and quality filtering

name: Reads that resolve naively
definition: The total number of reads that can be resolved into genetic and epigenetic sequences without prior pairwise alignment

name: Percentage of reads that resolve naively
definition: The percentage of trimmed reads that can be resolved into genetic and epigenetic sequences without prior pairwise alignment

name: Reads to rescue via pairwise alignment
definition: The total number of reads for which a pairwise alignment will be attempted in order to resolve into genetic and epigenetic sequences

name: Percentage of reads to rescue via pairwise alignment
definition: The percentage of trimmed reads for which a pairwise alignment will be attempted in order to resolve into genetic and epigenetic sequences

name: Reads rescued via pairwise alignment
definition: The number of reads that were able to be resolved into genetic and epigenetic sequences after a pairwise alignment

name: Percentage of reads rescued via pairwise alignment
definition: The percentage of reads for which a pairwise alignment was attempted that were able to be resolved into genetic and epigenetic sequences after a pairwise alignment

name: Total resolved reads
definition: The total number of resolved reads usable for downstream analysis (made up of those that resolved naively and those that were rescued)

name: Percentage of trimmed reads that resolve
definition: The percentage of trimmed, quality-filtered reads usable for downstream analysis (made up of those that resolved naively and those that were rescued)

name: Percentage of input reads that resolve
definition: The percentage of the total input read pairs in the initial input FASTQ files that remains as resolved reads after processing through the resolution algorithm

name: Total discarded reads in resolution
definition: The total number of trimmed, quality-filtered reads discarded as not representing the expected construct / format to resolve into genetic / epigenetic sequences

name: Percentage of trimmed reads that are discarded
definition: The percentage of trimmed, quality-filtered reads discarded as not representing the expected construct / format to resolve into genetic / epigenetic sequences

name: Percentage of trimmed bases that resolve
definition: The percentage of trimmed, quality-filtered bases available for downstream analysis after resolution and further trimming

name: Percentage of input bases that resolve
definition: The percentage of the total input base-pairs in the initial input FASTQ files that remains as resolved bases after processing through the resolution algorithm

name: Total input read pairs
definition: The total number of read-pairs (R1/R2 read-pairs) provided as input to the pipeline

name: Reads discarded during trimming
definition: Number of read-pairs filtered out after trimming as too short or having too many N

name: R1 processed bases
definition: Total number of R1 bases provided as input to the pipeline

name: R2 processed bases
definition: Total number of R2 bases provided as input to the pipeline

name: R1 hairpins trimmed
definition: Total number of hairpins trimmed from R1

name: R2 hairpins trimmed
definition: Total number of hairpins trimmed from R2

name: R1 poly-G tails trimmed
definition: Total number of R1 poly-G tails trimmed. If 9 or more consecutive G's are observed at the end of a read, then these as inferred to be an artefact of sequencing and are trimmed off.

name: R2 poly-G tails trimmed
definition: Total number of R2 poly-G tails trimmed. If 9 or more consecutive G's are observed at the end of a read, then these as inferred to be an artefact of sequencing and are trimmed off.

name: Percentage of input reads remaining after trimming and quality filtering
definition: The percentage of the total input reads in the initial input FASTQ files that is remaining after initial trimming and quality filtering in the prelude module

name: Percentage of input bases remaining after trimming and quality filtering
definition: The percentage of the total input bases in the initial input FASTQ files that is remaining after initial trimming and quality filtering in the prelude module
